paras: The VW’s have very fussy CANBUS systems, and changing those number plate lights are almost always going to give you a pesky "bulb out" dash warning.
We've got a simple plug and play error free solution! Full replacement units that have enough resistance to keep the CANBUS system happy, whilst improving the brightness and aesthetics by ten-fold.
hl: High end components for stable quality
ft: NUMBER PLATE : VW GOLF / POLO / SCIROCCO / PASSAT / EOS
